results.snippet:
Consult the brochure

## Admissions

### Prerequisites

 CTI-accredited engineering degree (Bac+5)
 Master’s degree M2 (Bac+5)
 University diplomas at M1 or Maîtrise level (Bac+4) and three years’ professional experience
 Foreign diplomas of equivalent level (Bac+5)

### Admission process

The candidate’s application is studied by the educational supervisor and then submitted to an admissions jury, which meets 4 times between March and June.

The candidate is notified by email of the jury’s decision.

### Apply

Registrations for the 2027/28 session of the program are open accordingly:

 September 15, 2026, up to June 30, 2027, for French and European students,
 September 15, 2026, up to January 30, 2027, for International students. [...] For further information: candidature.mscse@imt-nord-europe.fr

To complete the 2027-2028 application form, click here

### Calendar

The year-long program alternates between academic coursework and professional experience in a company. Students may also choose the work-study track, which includes a full-time placement in industry from March to September.

Download information notice

## Program

THE FULL PROGRAMME

Designing information systems security projects
results.raw_content: [Skip to content](#content) [Homepage](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/en/) » [Continuous training](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/en/continuing-professional-training/) » Advanced Master® in Cybersecurity Engineering ![mastère spécialisé cybersécurité](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/im-mise-en-avant-cybersecurite-MS-e1759480473857.jpg) Advanced Masters # Advanced Master® in Cybersecurity Engineering The Advanced Master **in Cybersecurity Engineering provides expert training in IT security**, enabling students to master the implementation of information system security in companies, from risk identification to the development of security plans designed to protect vital company resources against internal and external attacks of all kinds. This program includes a 4- to 6-month internship at a company. **You also have the option of completing this program through a work-study arrangement (apprenticeship contract).** This program, accredited by the Conférence des Grandes Écoles, has been awarded the SecNumedu label by [ANSSI.](https://www.ssi.gouv.fr/) This Specialized Master’s degree is recognized by the French government and registered in the National Directory of Professional Certifications (RNCP) under code [41445](https://www.francecompetences.fr/recherche/rncp/41445/). ![](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/MS_RVB-scaled-e1776410584108-600x164.png) ![](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Logo_CGE_2019.png) ![](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/secnumedu.png) ![](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Logo-francecompetences-e1776762392172.png) ![](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Logo-mon-compte-formation-e1764680075695.png) Our course is ranked among the best Masters, MS & MBA [**Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Big Data**](https://meilleurs-masters.com/master-informatique-intelligence-artificielle-et-big-data_5.html) in the **Hauts-de-France** region: ## Skills * Acquire the fundamentals of system security (configuration, operating systems, servers and networks). * Master cryptographic techniques and mechanisms to secure data and communications. * Detect threats and vulnerabilities to implement response strategies. * Audit and evaluate IT systems to identify potential security flaws and propose solutions. * Assess and manage cybersecurity risks within an organization. * Understand and comply with cybersecurity standards and regulations. * Manage secure networks, and protect them from network attacks * Analyze security data to detect threats * Manage cybersecurity projects, from concept to implementation. * Develop a strong professional ethic and awareness of the importance of IT security. * Raise security awareness and effectively communicate security issues * Understand Ethical Hacking techniques, and acquire programming skills. These skills will prepare you to face the ever-changing challenges of cybersecurity and to take up positions of responsibility within organizations concerned with protecting their digital assets against threats. ## Perspectives and professions * Cybersecurity Expert * Cybersecurity Consultant * Cybersecurity Manager * Security and Network Architect * Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) * Data Protection Officer * Information Security Risk Manager * Information Security Manager * Computer Network Security Manager * Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) [Consult the brochure](https://www.calameo.com/read/00522272064b82ecac6bc "Consult the brochure") ## Admissions ### Prerequisites * CTI-accredited engineering degree (Bac+5) * Master’s degree M2 (Bac+5) * University diplomas at M1 or Maîtrise level (Bac+4) and three years’ professional experience * Foreign diplomas of equivalent level (Bac+5) ### Admission process The candidate’s application is studied by the educational supervisor and then submitted to an admissions jury, which meets 4 times between March and June. The candidate is notified by email of the jury’s decision. ### Apply Registrations for the 2027/28 session of the program are open accordingly: * September 15, 2026, up to June 30, 2027, for French and European students, * September 15, 2026, up to January 30, 2027, for International students. For further information: [candidature.mscse@imt-nord-europe.fr](mailto:candidature.mscse@imt-nord-europe.fr) To complete the 2027-2028 application form, [**click here**](https://e-services.imt-nord-europe.fr/my-form/registration/form/72) ### Calendar The year-long program alternates between **academic coursework and professional experience in a company**. Students may also choose the work-study track, which includes a full-time **placement in industry from March to September.** [Download information notice](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Notice_MS26.27VF.pdf "Download information notice") ## Program [THE FULL PROGRAMME](https://imt-nord-europe.fr/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/MS-cyber-programme-detaille_EN.pdf) [Designing information systems security projects](#syllabus-tabs-0) * By identifying and qualifying risks * By conducting audits and pentesting operations * By formulating recommendations for cyber prevention and security * By planning and managing projects and their interdependencies * By managing and leading the company’s cyber team * By reporting on project progress * By using technical and functional project specifications [Implementing and administering information system security solutions](#syllabus-tabs-1) * By configuring information system parameters * By managing and operating access rights * By updating documentation * By verifying the application of security rules * By identifying vulnerabilities [Managing incidents and crisis situations](#syllabus-tabs-2) * By creating and deploying a Business Continuity and Recovery Plan (BCRP) * By managing the SOC * By detecting incidents, intrusions, and network anomalies * By measuring the impact of Incidents and qualifying incidents * Ensuring internal and external communication * Ensuring incident post-mortems [Ensuring monitoring, advice, and information on information systems security](#syllabus-tabs-3) * Monitoring technical and regulatory developments in cybersecurity * Raising awareness and training teams on IT security issues * Providing strategic advice on quality in terms of system robustness and resilience * Verifying regulatory compliance Head teacher Ahmed MEDDAHI ## Further information **The programme is fully taught in French.** ### Fees Application fee: €60 non-refundable. Programme fees : * **€9,000** for young graduates continuing their studies, jobseekers or people financing their own education ; * **Companies**, contact us. ### Lieu de la formation Rue Guglielmo Marconi, 59650 Villeneuve-d’Ascq ## Contact [candidature.mscse@imt-nord-europe.fr](javascript:;) [+33 3 27 71 20 30](tel:+33327712030) "\*" indicates required fields Gérer le consentement aux cookies We use cookies to optimize our website and our service. results.raw_content: [![CYBERSURE](/logos/L Color CyberSure.svg)](/) # Admission Your journey to becoming a cybersecurity professional starts here. Learn about our admission process and requirements. Welcome to the CYBERSURE admission process. We are looking for motivated students with a strong academic background and passion for cybersecurity who want to join our world-class programme. CYBERSURE is a prestigious Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree programme offering full scholarships and partial scholarships to exceptional candidates from around the world. Our admission process is designed to identify candidates who demonstrate academic excellence, technical aptitude, and commitment to advancing the field of cybersecurity. ### Key Information Application Period November 16th. 2026 - January 4th. 2027 Applications open November 16th. 2026 from 09:00 AM (GMT +1) and will be closed by January 4th. 2027 23:59 PM (GMT +1). [**Apply now!**](https://fsweb.no/soknadsweb/login.jsf?inst=ntnu) Programme Capacity 25-35 Students per Year We accept a limited number of highly qualified students to ensure personalized attention and quality education. Scholarship Opportunities Full & Partial Scholarships Available Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover tuition fees, travel costs, and provide a monthly allowance for living expenses. International Programme Open to All Nationalities We welcome applications from students worldwide. The programme is taught entirely in English across seven European universities. ## Admission Requirements * •**Bachelor's Degree**: In Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field * •**Academic Excellence**: Strong academic record with minimum GPA requirements * •**English Proficiency**: TOEFL, IELTS, or equivalent certification required * •**Motivation**: Clear statement of purpose demonstrating interest in cybersecurity * •**References**: Two academic or professional recommendation letters ### Application round for the 2027 student intake | Selection Schedule | Details | | --- | --- | | 16. November 2026 | Application period begins, and the online application form opens. | | 4. January 2027 | Application deadline, online form closes. Deadline for submitting the online application form with all requested documents. | | 18. January 2027 | Deadline for English test results to arrive the CYBERSURE Admissions Office | | January – February 2027 | * Eligibility check of submitted applications * Academic evaluation of applications | | February/March 2027 | Selection results are shared with candidates mid-March. | | March 2027 | Release of selection results from the first application round at the latest | | For selected students | | 31. May 2027 | Deadlines for accepting offers will be shortened and are instructed in the acceptance letter. | | 31. July 2027 | Deadline to graduate for applicants who applied with an incomplete degree. | | 15. August 2027 | Deadline for the certified copy of degree certificates and transcripts to arrive at CYBERSURE Admissions Office for all selected applicants. | ### General Eligibility Requirements #### Recognized Institution Your previous higher education institution needs to be officially recognized. #### Degree Requirements Your previous degree needs to meet our requirements. #### English Proficiency Test scores must fulfill minimum requirements and be submitted before the deadline. #### Complete Application Submit your online application and all compulsory documents before the deadline. Previous Higher Education Institution and Degree Applicants should hold a Bachelor degree\* awarded by a university or a higher education institution. The awarding institution has to be a recognized part of the official national education system of the country, i.e., to be listed as a degree-granting higher education institution by the country where it is located or by a relevant international organization such as UNESCO. The scope of a relevant degree awarded by a higher education institution must be equivalent to 180 ECTS credits or at least three years of full-time study. The degree must give eligibility for Master's degree studies in the awarding country. **\*) Applicants outside of the EU/EEA** are required to submit their final degree documents (degree certificates and consolidated transcripts of records) by the application deadline. **\*) Applicants within EU/EEA** in their final year of studies must submit their most recent transcripts by the application deadline and are eligible to admission provided that they will graduate by 31 July 2027. Certified copies must arrive at CYBERSURE Admission Office by August 15th. 2027. If the applicant cannot graduate on time or fails to deliver a degree certificate by the given deadline, their conditional acceptance to the programme will be cancelled. The CYBERSURE Consortium reserves the right to determine whether the higher education institution or the degree fulfils the requirements. All questions related to degrees and accreditation should be sent to [**[email protected]**](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#f49590999d87879d9b9a87d9999587809186b48795da9a809a81da9a9b). English Language Proficiency Our language of instruction is English, and applicants are expected to have an excellent command of it. The accepted language tests and their minimum score requirements are listed below. | Minimum Total Score | Minimum Writing Score | Minimum score for each section | | --- | --- | --- | | IELTS (Academic) | 6.5 | 6.0 | - | | TOEFL iBT (Internet-based Test) \*(when the exam has been completed before 21.1.2026) | 92 | 22 | - | | TOEFL iBT (Internet based Test) \*(when the exam was taken on or after 21.1.2026) | 4.5 | 4.5 | 4.5 | | C1 Advanced (former Cambridge Certificate of Advanced English, CAE) | A,B, or C | - | - | | C2 Proficiency (former Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English, CPE) | A,B, C or C1 | - | - | Important * •The minimum requirements are very strict. If your scores do not fulfill the minimum score requirements, your application will not be processed further. * •You cannot combine scores from different test dates (e.g., TOEFL MyBest scores are not accepted). * •IELTS and TOEFL results are valid for two years starting from the test date. Test results from the tests taken on or after 16. November 2024 is acceptable in the 2027 application round. * •IELTS Online (Academic) and TOEFL iBT Home Edition are accepted in the 2027 admission. Only the language tests listed above are accepted. For further information on language test result deadline and submitting your test scores for verification, see the deadline overview. All questions regarding English tests should be sent to [**[email protected]**](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#4120252c283232282e2f326c2c20323524330132206f2f352f346f2f2e). #### Exemptions from the English Language Test Requirement Exemption 1 Applicants whose higher education degree has been taken at an English medium programme requiring physical on-site presence at a university in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, the United States, an EU/EEA country and Switzerland. * • If the degree is completed in an EU/EEA country (except Ireland), Switzerland or Canada, the language of the degree must be stated unambiguously in the degree certificate or its appendix, or in the transcript of records or other official document issued by the awarding higher education institution. * • A minimum of one half of the degree must be completed in a country and higher education institution that meets the requirements for exempting the applicant from taking an English test. Exemption 2 Degree students form the CYBERSURE Consortium universities (NTNU, Aalto, DTU, UT, EURECOM, KTH, TU Graz). * • A minimum of one half of the degree must be completed at a Consortium university. Exemption 3 Applicants who have attended CYBERSURE Consortium universities (NTNU, Aalto, DTU, UT, EURECOM, KTH, TU Graz) as exchange students. All other applicants are expected to present a valid English language test result without exceptions. ### Student Selection Criteria Admission to the CYBERSURE programme is granted on a competitive basis, and applicants are assessed based on their previous academic record. The selection is document-based. In case you have questions related to the academic background (i.e. courses, skills etc.), please contact us at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#4627222b2f35352f292806253f242334353334236b2b2735322334682333). The final evaluation of eligible applications and ranking of qualified students is made based on the following criteria: Evaluation Process: During the evaluation process, we assess relevance of previous studies and academic performance first. Only applications that meet the requirements for these two criteria will be evaluated further. ## Application Documents CYBERSURE's application process is conducted fully online. **All application documents must be uploaded to the online application portal** **before the application deadline. The application documents should clearly indicate what they contain.** Please read instructions carefully. ##### Post-Admission Requirements CYBERSURE’s application process is conducted fully online. \*\*The application documents must be uploaded to the online application portal before the application deadline. \*\*After the admissions results are published, the selected CYBERSURE students must submit certified (attested) copies of the bachelor’s degree certificate and transcript of records, fulfilling the country-specific requirements, by the given deadline. Admission is conditional until certified hard copies of the documents have been received. The conditionally granted study right will be cancelled if the certified documents are not received as requested The certified documents will be compared to the documents uploaded to the application portal. During the admission phase, CYBERSURE Admissions Office will perform spot checks on educational documents with the issuing universities. ### Compulsory Application Documents 1. Check Required Country-Specific Documents Check if you need to gather Country Specific Documents in the list below. These documents may take a long time to acquire, so make sure to start early with this step! 2. Bachelor's Degree Certificate/Diploma Scanned color copy of the original Bachelor degree certificate/diploma or a certificate of equivalent studies (if graduated) ●Original document in color ●Clear and legible scan 3. Translation of Degree Certificate Authorized translation of the degree certificate/diploma into English, if applicable ●Must be done by the issuing institution or a certified translator ●Include translator's stamp and signature 4. Official Transcripts of Records Scanned color copy of all the original official transcripts of records ●Must show all courses and grades ●Include GPA or equivalent grading scale 5. Translation of Transcripts Authorized translation of the transcripts of records into English, if applicable ●Official word-for-word translation ●Certified translator's stamp and signature required 6. Motivation Video and Motivation Letter A motivation video and letter that clearly state your goals and expectations about applying to CYBERSURE, and demonstrate your commitment to the programme. It should also indicate what specialization track you prefer, and why. Both will be submitted as PDFs in the application portal. ●Motivation video (max. 1 minute, 100 MB) must be submitted by placing the video link in a separate PDF. Do not include the link in any other document or in the comment field. ●Motivation letter (max. 500 words, exceeding words will not be evaluated) 7. Curriculum Vitae Comprehensive CV highlighting your academic and professional background ●Include education, work experience, and achievements ●List relevant skills and certifications 8. Copy of Valid Passport or ID Copy of a valid passport or an official government-issued identification card with photo, including information on citizenship ●Must be valid ●Photo and personal details clearly visible ●In case of more than one citizenships, all must be documented 9. Proof of Place of Residency Document proving your current place of residence ●Recent utility bill or official document ●Clearly shows name and address 10. Proof of English Language Proficiency Official test scores demonstrating English language proficiency ●Must meet minimum score requirements ●Test scores must be submitted before the deadline 11. For students that apply as self-funded If you should wish to participate in the programme as a **self-financed** student in the event you don't apply for or are not awarded a scholarship, you are required to upload documentation of financing in accordance with the Norwegian Visa regulations along with your other documents within the deadline provided by [**NTNU Financing**](https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/financing-and-scholarships). ### Additional Application Documents Two Academic Recommendation Letters Recommended To be submitted in the application portal Course Descriptions Important Course descriptions of relevant courses taken Additional Higher Education Optional Scanned color copies of other higher education degrees or studies (if taken), and their transcripts with authorized translations (if applicable). E.g. Master's degree studies, exchange studies, additional non-degree studies. Work Certificates & Publications Optional Copies of relevant work certificates, publications, or other relevant activities (if available) GMAT/GRE Test Result Optional GMAT or GRE test result (if available) ### Country Specific Documents ##### For Admitted Students Only After the admissions results are published in March 2027, the applicants selected to CYBERSURE must submit certified (attested) hard copies of their Bachelor's degree certificate and transcript of records by **15. August 2027**. For certain countries, we have additional country-specific requirements (see below). Please note that these requirements apply **only to applicants admitted to CYBERSURE**. Submission Deadline 15. August 2027 Submit documents to [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#0766636a6e74746e686947647e656275747275622a6a6674736275296272) Mail / Courier / In Person Please ensure all certified documents are submitted before the deadline. Admission is conditional until certified hard copies are received. ##### Translation Requirements All application documents must be made available in English.If the original documents are not issued in English, the applicant must provide official, word-for-word translations of them. The translation is official if it has been done by: * The higher education institution that awarded the degree * A certified translator (authorized translator) * The translations must have the certified translator's stamp and signature. ## How to Apply CYBERSURE's admission process consists of the following 6 steps. Note that you can complete the first two steps before our application period begins. **Make sure to read all the instructions carefully**. ##### Application Period 2026/2027 Intake Submit during the application window. Ensure all required materials are ready before the deadline. Open: November 16th., 2026 at 9:00 AM (GMT+1) Deadline: January 4th., 2027 at 23:59 PM (GMT+1) ### Application Steps Step 1 Study the admission requirements Can start early Before you begin the application process, check your compliance with our [**admission requirements**](https://cybersure-master.eu/admission/requirements). * ●Review all admission requirements carefully * ●Check if you need to provide Country Specific documents and start collecting them early * ●Ensure you meet the educational background criteria * ●Check English language proficiency requirements * ●Verify your bachelor's degree is from a recognized institution Step 2 Prepare for the admission Can start early If an English language test is required from you and you have not taken the test yet, book a seat for it immediately. **Important note for self-funded students:** If you apply as self-funded, you are required to upload [documentation of financing according to the Norwegian Visa regulations](https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/financing-and-scholarships). * ●Applications without a valid English test result are not eligible and will not be processed further * ●Start collecting your application documents * ●In case you apply as a self-funded student, you are required to upload documentation of financing * ●Prepare your motivation video * ●Contact potential recommenders early * ●Reflect over your second year specialization preferences * ●If you intend to apply for a Special Needs scholarship, prepare a short application (maximum 200 words) as a separate PDF. Step 3 Fill in and submit the online application Complete and submit the [**online application form**](https://fsweb.no/soknadsweb/login.jsf?inst=ntnu) during the application period. Make sure to **upload all required application documents in the application portal according to the** [**"Compulsory Application Documents" list**](https://cybersure-master.eu/admission/documents), and check the “Country Specific Documents" section in case anything extra is needed. **Important note for self-funded students:** If you apply as self-funded, you are required to upload [documentation of financing according to the Norwegian Visa regulations](https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/financing-and-scholarships). If you experience trouble with your application once in the portal, contact [**[email protected]**](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#7617121b1f05051f1918055b1b17050213043605175818021803581819). * ●Choose "Login International Applicant" and create a user * ●Create a new application, find the programme beneath "Master's Degree Programmes" > "Erasmus Mundus Programmes" * ●We advice you to rank all 6 second-year specializations (we cannot guarantee that your preferences will be met) * ●Upload all the required documents (make sure to mark them with name and type of docuement, i.e. "Motivation Video", "Course Descriptions", "References" etc. * ●Ensure your motivation video link is working well * ●Indicate the type of scholarships you want to apply for (read more in the "Scholarships and fees" section) * ●In case you would like to apply for an additional special needs scholarship, specify this in the comment field. * ●If you are self-funded, you must upload documentation of financing **Important:** Late or incomplete applications will not be accepted. Step 4 Submit your language test scores (if required) If an official English language test result is required from you, submit it according to test-specific instructions. * ●All language test results are verified * ●Only the language tests listed under Admission requirements are accepted. * ●Final deadline: January 18, 2027 * ●There are no exceptions to this deadline * ●If you submit your English test results before the application deadline, upload them through the application portal. * ●If you submit your English test results after the application deadline, but before the final language test deadline, upload your test result through Søknadsweb and clearly mark the document “English Test Results”. * ●After uploading your test result in Søknadsweb, you must also send a confirmation email to [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection). The email subject must include your application number and “English Test Results”. * ●Do not submit English test results by email. The email is only used to confirm that the result has been uploaded in Søknadsweb. Step 5 Monitor your e-mail for our response After submitting your application, CYBERSURE Admissions Office will check it and send you an update. * ●Submitted applications are checked in order of arrival * ●CYBERSURE Admission Office at NTNU will send you an e-mail * ●You may be asked to complement your application if required * ●Keep your email address up to date Step 6 If your application is eligible, wait for the selection results The academic staff evaluates eligible applications and makes the final selection and scholarship decisions. * ●Academic evaluation takes place in January-February 2027 * ●Selection results will be published in mid-March 2027 * ●All eligible applicants will be informed by e-mail * ●Admission letters and practical instructions will be sent to selected students * ●Rectification request option available within 14 days after results publication ### Important Information Online Application Process The application process is fully conducted online in the application portal. You do not need to send us any application documents by regular mail, unless anything else is stated. See the "Application Documents" section for further information about Country Specific Documents. Document Deadlines Please note the separate deadlines given to language test results. Make sure all documents are submitted before their respective deadlines. Rectification Request After the selection results have been published, applicants have the possibility to request for rectification within 21 days. New documents cannot be submitted. Scholarship decisions cannot be appealed. ### Language Test Submission Instructions ##### Language Test Deadline The final deadline for the English language test result to be received by the CYBERSURE Admissions Office is January 18., 2027. There are no exceptions to this deadline. The English Test result must be uploaded in Søknadsweb. For questions related to English tests, contact [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection). ### Application Timeline Nov 16th., 2026 Application Portal Opens 9:00 AM (GMT+1) Jan 4th., 2027 Application Deadline 23:59 PM (GMT+1)- Late applications will not be accepted Jan 18th., 2027 Language Test Deadline Final deadline for test results - No exceptions Jan-Feb 2027 Academic Evaluation Consortium universities evaluate applications Mid-Mar 2027 Selection Results Published All eligible applicants informed by email ##### Need Help? If you encounter any issues during the application process or have questions, please contact the CYBERSURE Admissions Office at NTNU. For questions related to English language requirements, degrees and accreditation contact [**[email protected].**](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#3a5b5e575349495355544917575b494e5f487a495b14544e544f145455) For questions related to the academic requirements, contact [**[email protected]**](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#c2a3a6afabb1b1abadac82a1bba0a7b0b1b7b0a7efafa3b1b6a7b0eca7b7). * • Review uploading instructions and browser support information * • Contact the above for specific queries ## Selection of Second-Year Specialization Student mobility in two countries other than your home country is a part of the requirements of this programme. All CYBERSURE students take their entire first year of studies at NTNU. The first semester is conducted in Trondheim, the second semester in Gjøvik. The second year will be conducted with one of the 6 specializations at the partner universities.
